items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: recreate a couple of things that Coleman Hawkins and I had done in Paris many years earlier with the two French saxophone players, Andre Ekyan, the altoist, and Alex Combelle

ctx.x: You know? But I did like Paris; I met John Reinhardt and Stephen Corpelli, and Alex Combelle and oh, Phil Brun and Arthur Briggs -- people like that.
